description: Job Information Date Opened 11/10/2026 Job Type Permanent Industry Electronics City Chennai State/Province Tamil Nadu Country India Zip/Postal Code 600096 Job Description Electronics Design Engineer - We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Design Engineer Intern to join our Industry 4.0 / IoT product development team. The selected candidate will assist in the design, development, and testing of embedded electronic systems and connected devices that form the backbone of smart industrial solutions. Key Responsibilities Assist in the design and development of electronic circuits for Industry 4.0 / IoT devices. Support PCB design, component selection, and schematic capture activities. Work on sensor integration, signal conditioning, and power management circuits. Interface with microcontrollers, communication modules (Wi-Fi, BLE, RS485, Modbus, etc.), and peripheral devices. Participate in prototype assembly, testing, and debugging of hardware boards. Collaborate with software and firmware teams for integration and functional testing. Maintain documentation for design updates, testing, and component specifications. Explore emerging IoT hardware technologies and Industry 4.0 applications. Requirements Technical Skills Required Good understanding of analog and digital circuit design fundamentals. Familiarity with microcontroller-based systems (Arduino, ESP32, STM, Raspberry Pi, etc.). Basic knowledge of communication interfaces – UART, SPI, I²C, RS485, Modbus. Exposure to PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, EasyEDA, etc.). Hands-on experience using test equipment (multimeter, oscilloscope, etc.). Basic understanding of embedded C / Python for hardware testing (preferred). Preferred Knowledge (Good to Have) Understanding of IoT system architecture – sensors, gateways, cloud connectivity. Experience with industrial automation concepts or embedded product prototyping. Awareness of power supply design and EMI/EMC considerations. Familiarity with hardware debugging and prototype validation. Electronics Engineer - Projects Job Description Assist in electronics solutions activities under supervision. Work on testing, troubleshooting, and calibration of electronic assemblies and instruments. Support solution development projects (test setups, prototyping, documentation). Assist the engineering team in preparing technical reports, service logs, and documentation. Participate in on-site service/project support if required. Research and learn about new tools, equipment, and solutions relevant to projects. Requirements Pursuing or completed B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics or related fields. Fresh graduates interested in building a career in Electronics Services / Technical Solutions. Basic knowledge of electronic circuits, measurement instruments, and troubleshooting. Robotics Engineer - Projects About the Role We are looking for enthusiastic and innovative engineering graduates to join our Industrial Automation team as Robot Programmers (Freshers). Key Responsibilities Learn and assist in programming industrial robots for automation applications. Support robot installation, commissioning, and testing activities. Perform robot teaching, calibration, and path optimization. Assist in integrating robots with PLCs, sensors, vision systems, and HMIs. Troubleshoot robotic and automation system issues. Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Prepare technical documentation and project reports. Follow safety standards and project quality requirements. Travel to customer sites for project implementation when required. Educational Qualification B.E./B.Tech in: Mechatronics Engineering Robotics & Automation Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE) Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) Mechanical Engineering Instrumentation Engineering Technical Sales Engineer We are seeking energetic and motivated Technical Sales Engineers to support our business growth through market research, lead generation, customer engagement, and technical sales activities. Candidates with an interest in technology, sales, marketing, and industrial solutions are encouraged to apply. Engineering qualification is preferred but not mandatory . Candidates from science, technology, business, or other relevant backgrounds with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are welcome. Key Responsibilities Conduct market research to identify potential customers, industry trends, and business opportunities. Generate leads and support customer acquisition activities. Promote and market the company's products and project solutions. Understand customer requirements and propose suitable technical solutions. Prepare presentations, quotations, and proposals. Follow up with prospective customers and maintain business relationships. Coordinate with technical teams for customer demonstrations and project discussions. Participate in exhibitions, seminars, social media promotions, and marketing campaigns. Products & Projects Candidates will be involved in promoting and selling Electronic Products / Automation projects / Digital Technology Solutions (MES / Traceability) / Industry 4.0 related products. Eligibility Any Graduate / Diploma Holder / Final-Year Student. Freshers and Internship applicants are welcome. Strong interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology-driven solutions. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to learn technical concepts and interact with customers. Basic knowledge of Electronics will be an added advantage but is not mandatory. Eligible Branches: B.Sc (Physics), B.Sc (Chemistry), BBA, MBA (Marketing). BE (ECE / Mechanical / Electrical / Robotics & Automation / Mechatronics / Computer Science / IT) students can also be considered, provided they are interested for Technical Sales (Field Sales). Eligibility Criteria for all the above positions - 80% and above throughout academics (10th, 12th, Diploma/UG). No active arrears/backlogs. Willingness to travel across India for project execution. Salary Package - Monthly Gross-Rs. 30K (Annual CTC - Around Rs. 4 LPA). Selected candidates should be willing to sign "Service Agreement for a period of 3 years".

title: Electronics & Embedded Systems Intern
description: Job Description We are looking for electronics and electrical engineering interns interested in embedded systems, motor control, sensors, robotics and automation. The selected candidates will work on the electronic control architecture of robotic arms, including motor drivers, encoders, power distribution, communication interfaces, sensors and hardware safety systems. Roles and Responsibilities Research and select suitable motors and actuators for robotic joints. Work on servo motor, BLDC motor and stepper motor control systems as appropriate. Integrate motor drivers, encoders and feedback systems. Develop communication interfaces between motors and the robot controller. Work with UART, CAN, RS485, USB and other relevant communication protocols. Develop power distribution systems for multiple robotic joints. Integrate sensors for joint position, movement and system monitoring. Work on emergency stop systems and hardware safety circuits. Implement limit switches, overcurrent protection and other safety mechanisms. Support electronics integration with ROS 2 and the software control architecture. Perform motor calibration, electrical testing and troubleshooting. Work with the mechanical team to integrate motors, wiring and electronics into robotic arms. Required Skills Basic knowledge of electronics and electrical circuits Understanding of microcontrollers and embedded systems Basic knowledge of sensors and motor control Interest in robotics and automation Good to Have Arduino / ESP32 / STM32 Raspberry Pi CAN / RS485 / UART communication Servo and BLDC motor control PCB design Power electronics Embedded C / C++ Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹7,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

title: Mechanical Design & Robotics Engineering Intern
description: Job Description We are looking for mechanical engineering interns interested in robotic arm design, mechanical systems, automation and product development. The selected candidates will work on designing and developing fixed-base, six-degree-of-freedom robotic arms. They will be involved in mechanical design, CAD modelling, fabrication, assembly, testing and optimization of robotic arms and grippers. Roles and Responsibilities Study the robotic arm mechanical architecture and reference designs. Design and develop 6-DOF robotic arm structures. Create 3D CAD models, mechanical drawings and assembly designs. Design robotic arm links, joints, brackets, shafts and mounting structures. Work on actuator mounting, gearboxes, pulleys, belts and transmission systems. Design and develop robotic grippers for handling cooking utensils and objects. Design leader and follower robotic arm mechanisms for teleoperation. Perform mechanical load, torque and structural calculations. Work on arm reach, payload capacity, stability and movement optimization. Coordinate with the electronics team for motor and encoder integration. Coordinate with the AI team for joint movement and teleoperation testing. Participate in fabrication, assembly, calibration and mechanical testing. Required Skills Basic knowledge of mechanical design and engineering principles Knowledge of 3D CAD software Understanding of mechanisms, joints and mechanical assemblies Interest in robotics and automation Good to Have SolidWorks / Fusion 360 / AutoCAD Robotics and mechatronics Gearbox and transmission design 3D printing and CNC fabrication Structural analysis and FEA Servo motors, actuators and robotic grippers Preferred Academic Background: B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics or related disciplines. Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

title: Product Development Software Intern
description: About Buildify Buildify is a custom software company in Chennai. We build ERP, POS, LMS, e-commerce platforms and websites for clients, along with fully custom software and our own software startup products. We care about shipping quality work quickly, and our team works hands-on with live products every day. About the Role You will work directly with the founder and a team lead on Buildify's internal tools and core products, and help take those products from build to launch. You will also work on live client projects, which gives you all-round experience across development, testing and automation. This is a technical, hands-on role. It is not a research or marketing role. Responsibilities Build and maintain internal tools and Buildify's core software products Develop features using JavaScript, React and Next.js, with Supabase/PostgreSQL for data Integrate AI systems and APIs into products and internal workflows Build automations that save time for the team and for clients Contribute to live client projects across ERP, POS, LMS, e-commerce and websites Test features, report bugs and fix issues before release Take part in sprint planning, code reviews and product launches Document what you build so the team can use and extend it Requirements Good knowledge of web technologies: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS and Git Good knowledge of new-age AI systems, including LLM APIs and how AI features fit into products Basic understanding of software development concepts and agile workflows Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and learn independently Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related field Able to work on-site in Chennai and commit 15-20 hours per week Good to have Projects of your own, such as deployed apps or AI-based tools Experience with Next.js, Supabase or Node.js Prior AI experience is a plus but not required What you will gain Hands-on experience building and launching real software products Exposure to testing, automation and live client delivery Direct guidance from the founder and a team lead A portfolio of shipped work Internship Details Location: On-site, Maduravoyal, Chennai Commitment: 15-20 hours per week Duration: 3 months Compensation: First month unpaid, then ₹4,000-6,000 per month based on performance

title: AI Engineer - Intern (Autonomous Driving)
description: AI Engineer - Intern (Autonomous Driving) — Tempero About Kedge and Tempero Kedge Systems Private Limited (https://kedge360.com/) is hiring 2–3 software developer interns for 5–6 months, starting December 2026 or January 2027, to build AI-driven Python tools for the Tempero project. Kedge is a Chennai-based software consulting company, in business since 2008, with a team of 30 across Chennai and Bangalore working for European clients. Tempero (https://tempero.tech/) works on scenario-based validation for simulation testing of autonomous driving systems: scenario intelligence, causal analysis of scenarios, and software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing with simulators such as CarMaker, DYNA4 and esmini. description: AI Power Electronics & Hardware Engineer Intern 1 About Power Flux AI Power Flux AI is an AI-native power electronics engineering company headquartered in Pune, India. We design, simulate, prototype and productionize high-power motor and inverter systems, from 0.5 kW to 500 kW, on a proprietary AI-driven platform. It compresses traditional 1836 month development cycles into 90 days from concept to prototype. We work with partners and institutions including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras and ARAI Pune, and our engineering is led by a founder with 35+ years of hands-on power electronics experience. 2 Your opportunity at IIT Madras Incubation, Chennai Work with us at the IIT Madras Incubation ecosystem in Chennai, alongside our Power Electronics Lab at IIT Madras. You will apply textbook power electronics to real designs, mentored by engineers with decades of hands-on motor and inverter experience. 3 Role overview You are the physical ground truth for our AI platform. You will write the sizing rules, constraints and simulation tests that make sure every AI-generated circuit is safe, stable and efficient. 4 What you will do Build automated sizing scripts for converter topologies such as LLC, Boost PFC and synchronous Buck/Boost. Model and test closed-loop controllers in SPICE. Create headless Ng spice test suites that check regulation, efficiency and power balance. Check that AI-generated schematics match KiCad netlists, with clean ERC/DRC. Write design-rule checks for IR drop, trace current capacity (IPC-2152), thermal limits and magnetic core saturation. 5 What you bring Must have Solid grounding in SMPS and power electronics fundamentals Ability to read and edit SPICE netlists (Ng spice, LTspice or similar) Python with NumPy/SciPy for calculations A project that simulated or built a converter Good to have KiCad or Altium PCB experience, pytest, Git, control theory (Bode, phase margin), magnetics design, resonant converters (LLC, DAB, PSFB).
